match.reason: The bank point teaches language register and diction in English, which is a different idea from registering a business and its legal requirements in Business Management.

draft.title: Registering a business
card: ABN
An Australian Business Number is an 11-digit number that identifies a business to the government and other businesses. A new business applies for one.
Business name
A name other than the owner's own must be registered with ASIC, the Australian Securities and Investments Commission. Many businesses also register a website domain that matches the name.
GST
A business must register for GST once its yearly turnover reaches the government's set limit. Turnover is the total sales before costs are taken out.
Licences
Some activities need a licence or permit before trading, such as serving food or selling alcohol. Which ones depend on what the business does.
draft.remember: Register what the business needs: an ABN, a name, GST once turnover passes the limit, and any licences for its activity.

a.q: Priya starts a bakery called Crust Co. She wants to trade under that name, not her own. What must she do about the name?
opts: Register it as a business name with ASIC
Apply for it as a GST registration
Ask the council for a food licence for it
Use it only after turnover passes the limit
a.why: A trading name that is not the owner's own name must be registered with ASIC. GST registration is about turnover, not names, so it does not cover the name.
a.clue: Which body does the card link to business names?

b.q: Tom's new dog-walking business in Geelong sold $30,000 of services in its first year. A friend says he must register for GST straight away because he is a new business. Why is the friend's reason wrong?
opts: GST registration depends on turnover reaching the limit
GST registration is only needed by businesses with a licence
GST registration is only needed once a name is registered
GST registration is done by getting an ABN
b.why: The card says GST registration is needed once turnover reaches the set limit, not simply because a business is new. A new business with turnover below the limit does not have to register on that basis. An ABN is a separate step.
b.clue: What does the card say triggers GST registration?

a.best: Register it as a business name with ASIC

b.best: GST registration depends on turnover reaching the limit

problems.detail: The remember line says GST registration is needed once turnover 'passes' the limit, but the card correctly says 'reaches' (the ATO requires registration at $75,000 or more). A business exactly at the limit must register, so 'reaches' should be used here too.
